title: Senior Product Manager
description:
**About Times Internet** 




 At Times Internet, we create premium digital products that simplify and enhance the lives of millions. As India’s largest digital products company, we have a significant presence across a wide range of categories, including News, Sports, Fintech, and Enterprise solutions.
 



  





 Our portfolio features market\-leading and iconic brands such as TOI, ET, NBT, Cricbuzz, Times Prime, Times Card, Indiatimes, Whatshot, Abound, Willow TV, Techgig and Times Mobile among many more. Each of these products is crafted to enrich your experiences and bring you closer to your interests and aspirations.
 



  





 As an equal opportunity employer, Times Internet strongly promotes inclusivity and diversity. We are proud to have achieved overall gender pay parity in 2018, verified by an independent audit conducted by Aon Hewitt.
 



  





 We are driven by the excitement of new possibilities and are committed to bringing innovative products, ideas, and technologies to help people make the most of every day. Join us and take us to the next level!
 



  





**About the Business Unit** 




  





 Times Prime is India’s first digital lifestyle membership for premium content and exclusive member\-benefits (https://www.timesprime.com/).
 



  





 Members get exclusive access to 25\+ subscriptions and 40\+ curated benefits from leading brands across Entertainment, Shopping, Essentials, Health \& Fitness, Content, Dining, Travel, and a lot more.
 



  





 100\+ leading players have partnered with Times Prime for customer gratification, acquisition, and other endeavors.
 



  





 Our clients include CitiBank, HDFC, Kotak Mahindra, IDFC First, Amazon, Tata Cliq, Samsung, Xiaomi, Flipkart, Myntra and many more
 



  





**About the Role** 




  





 As a Product Manager, you will play a key role in shaping the experience for Times Prime consumers. You will own the strategy, development, and execution of features that help consumers redeem the offers and ensuring their long\-term engagement. You will work to optimize the end\-to\-end consumer B2C experience.
 



  





 A Senior Product Manager will see the big picture and the small detail at the same time. He or she will own their area’s roadmap while understanding the broad needs of the business, spot trends and technical developments.
 



 At the same time, he or she will understand every detail of the product from research, design to functionality to usability. They will need to understand various B2C app metrics and concepts very well – conversion, repeat rates, ROI, performance metrics etc.
 



  





**Work Responsibilities** 




  





 Key Areas
 



 Own consumer experience, Funnels, north star metric and feature Roadmap. Ensuring an intuitive, engaging, and frictionless customer experience on Android, iOS and Mobile Sites.
 



 Strong understanding of UI/UX and brand language, with experience working with visual designers and using data and usability interviews to reduce design exploration.
 



 Build proven engagement loops using gamification, personalization and rewards to create repeat usage and improve retention.
 



 Use data\-driven insights to identify bottlenecks, optimize conversion rates, and reduce drop\-offs across key stages of the funnel.
 



 Work closely with marketing and analytics teams to integrate growth strategies such as user retention frameworks.
 



 Comfortable with user research: Customer calling, running surveys, organising Usability Testing Interviews.
 



  





 Leadership \& Stakeholder Management:
 



 Collaborate with senior executives and cross\-functional leaders to align product strategies with business goals including Alliance, Growth, Renewal, Strategy, Design and Analytics.
 



 Lead and mentor a team of junior product managers, instilling a culture of ownership, innovation, and excellence.
 



  





 Skills, Experience \& Expertise
 



 Proven expertise in managing discovery, engagement and growth\-focused products.
 



 Strong understanding of data analytics
 



 Ability to drive alignment across teams and lead through influence in a fast\-paced environment.
 



 A strong advocate for customer\-centric design and data\-driven decision\-making.
 



  





**Eligibility** 




 4\+ years of overall experience in product management
 



 3\+ years of product management experience in the B2C role, preferably in consumer tech Worked in fast paced consumer tech
 



 MBA/BTech from a premier institute

**📍 Location:** 
 Noida / Bangalore

 Product Management

 6\+ years (4\+ in Product)
 



  





**About PhysicsWallah** 




 PhysicsWallah (PW) is India's leading edtech company, redefining how millions of students from Bharat access high\-quality, affordable education. Our rapidly growing ecosystem spans online courses, offline centers, and a thriving e\-commerce business offering books, stationery, and more.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for a high\-ownership, execution\-focused Senior Product Manager to lead product efforts for
 **PW ECommerce** 
 initiatives. You will own and optimize end\-to\-end product purchase journeys and drive new product initiatives that support our growing business.
 



 This role demands systems thinking, clear prioritization, and strong cross\-functional leadership across tech, business, and design.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Drive product strategy and execution across homepage, PLPs, PDPs, cart, checkout, and post\-order experiences.
* Improve funnel metrics such as add\-to\-cart %, conversion rate, and repeat purchases.
* Build internal tools and dashboards to support catalog, inventory, logistics, and operations.
* Collaborate with supply chain, design, marketing, and category teams to ensure aligned product experiences and GTM rollouts.



  





**What We’re Looking For** 



* 6\+ years of total work experience, with 4\+ years in product management (e\-commerce, B2C tech, or platform businesses preferred).
* Prior experience in e\-commerce and/or edtech environments; familiarity with merchandising, logistics, and supply chain integrations is a plus.
* Strong understanding of user behavior in Tier 2/3 India and comfort designing for Bharat users.
* Excellent communication skills \- capable of aligning diverse stakeholders across legacy teams, acquired brands, and central product pods.
* Self\-starter with the ability to prioritize and thrive in ambiguity.
* Strong analytical skills \- experience working with GA4, SQL, Metabase, or experimentation tools.
* Proficiency with tools like Jira, Confluence, Figma, and other product management systems.
* Experience with Shopify, GoKwik, Clickpost, or similar e\-commerce platforms/stack.
* Bonus: Prior startup or founder experience.



  





**Why Join PW** 



* Work on high\-impact, high\-visibility products that touch millions of learners across India.
* Take full ownership \- ship fast, learn fast, and build deep.
* Be part of a passionate team driving real change at the grassroots level of education.
* Thrive in a mission\-driven, execution\-first environment.

title: Technical Product Manager
description:
We’re looking for an experienced Technical Product Manager to own our Jobs platform and take its capabilities to the next level. Your responsibilities would span the entire pipeline from ingestion, cleansing, and indexing of jobs as they come in; through searching and matching for both users in real\-time and offline notifications; to providing front\-end product interfaces to our web property product managers. All of this needs to happen at scale across our ecosystem of many millions of jobs and job seekers.
   

  

 This is an interdisciplinary role emphasizing breadth and orchestration across architecture, data engineering and science, development, analytics, and product management. A technical background is desirable and we expect a firm grasp of technical capabilities and concepts. You’ll at the very least be able to ‘read API’. However, more important is the ability to work with multiple teams to come up with a mix that works \- and works well \- for the end user. Key skills here are a strong analytical bent of mind for defining key metrics/benchmarks and measuring at scale, as well as the ability to hone in on the individual job seeker and answer the right questions: is her need being met? If not, how can we improve?
   

  

**Job Description**
**ABOUT THIS TEAM**
 BOLD Platform services team design, creates, manage and maintains the highly scalable and distributed services for the wider use of web and mobile product applications/portals/websites. The current list of services is based on Microservices architecture whose domain ranges from visitor tracking, User profiles, authentication, content and payments.
   

  

 Platform team uses state of the art modern technologies like .Net framework, Python, Java, SQL Server, My SQL, Graph DB, SOLR, and a lot of other tools \& technologies serving millions of users with hundreds of million transactions everyday through a scalable and fault tolerant architecture.
   

  

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**
* Work closely with North America product leadership to understand jobs product needs and use cases.
* Work closely with senior engineering management and architecture to plot the technical vision and roadmap for the platform.
* Design, implement, and support, in cooperation with other data teams and data scientists a platform to measure our jobs quality, coverage, and relevancy through manual and automatic mechanisms.
* Analyse and measure the quality and coverage of vendor feeds.
* Measure and improve our job recommendations and search capabilities.
* Work with internal teams to build dashboards which will be used by internal stakeholders (product, office of the CEO, analytics etc).
* Measure and improve jobs data quality to point out issues with jobs data/gaps with jobs data.
* Work with the data science team to build jobs evaluation ML models.
* Evaluate jobs data coverage for jobs within the BOLD system.
* Translate business requirements and develop an end to end solution.
* Design web\-scale products following best coding principles, optimized coding practices and using open source tools \& platforms.
* Proactively identify potential problems and opportunities to improve the data pipelines related to jobs data.


**WHAT YOU’LL NEED**
* Experience in the jobs domain with a good understanding of jobs, job matching, jobs recommendations.
* Proven track record of taking ownership, thinking strategically, and successfully delivering results in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment.
* Possess an understanding of technology stacks and level of efforts involved in order to be able to make right decisions.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills with demonstrated experience engaging and influencing senior executives.
* Strong attention to detail and proven ability to manage multiple, competing priorities simultaneously.
* Strong analytical and quantitative skills with the ability to use data and metrics to back up assumptions, recommendations and drive actions.
* Engineering/ Master’s Degree from a good Institute (preferably Computer Science or related).


**EXPERIENCE\-**
* Technical Product Manager\- 10 years\+


**BENEFITS**
**Outstanding Compensation**
* Competitive salary
* Tax\-friendly compensation structure
* Bi\-annual bonus
* Annual Appraisal
* Equity in company


**100% Full Health Benefits**
* Group Mediclaim, personal accident, \& term life insurance
* Group Mediclaim benefit (including parents' coverage)
* Online Health (OPD) Consultation Benefit
* Personal accident and term life insurance coverage


**Flexible Time Away**
* 24 days paid leaves
* Declared fixed holidays
* Paternity and maternity leave
* Compassionate and marriage leave
* Covid leave (up to 7 days)


**ADDITIONAL BENEFITS**
* Internet and home office reimbursement
* In\-office catered lunch, meals, and snacks
* Certification policy
* Cab pick\-up and drop\-off facility


**About BOLD**
**We Transform Work Lives**
 As an established global organization, BOLD helps people find jobs. Our story is one of growth, success, and professional fulfillment. We create digital products that have empowered millions of people in 180 countries to build stronger resumes, cover letters, and CVs. The result of our work helps people interview confidently, finding the right job in less time. Our employees are experts, learners, contributors, and creatives.
   

  

**We Celebrate And Promote Diversity And Inclusion**
 We value our position as an Equal Opportunity Employer. We hire based on qualifications, merit, and our business needs. We don't discriminate regarding race, color, religion, gender, pregnancy, national origin or citizenship, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, genetic information, or any other applicable characteristic protected by law.

title: About the Role
description:
Product Manager – Data \& Integrations
   

  

 📍
 **Location:** 
 Noida
   

  

 💼
 **Experience:** 
 4–7 Years
   

  

 🏢
 **Industry:** 
 Healthcare Technology / B2B SaaS
   

  

 👤
 **Reporting To:** 
 VP – Product
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a
 **Product Manager – Data \& Integrations** 
 to own the core data platform and integration ecosystem powering a growing healthcare technology business serving the US market.
   

  

 You will work closely with engineering, operations, and business teams to build a
 **scalable data layer, payer/third\-party integrations, data pipelines, and data quality framework** 
 that powers multiple products.
   

  

 What You Will Own
   

  

* Own and evolve the canonical data model based on the US healthcare claims lifecycle.
* Lead payer, clearinghouse, EDI, API, and third\-party integrations.
* Work with transaction formats such as 837, 835, 270/271 and 276/277\.
* Own 835/ERA parsing and payment\-posting logic.
* Design scalable client data onboarding processes across different EHR/PM systems.
* Define data contracts and requirements for Azure SQL, Snowflake and data pipelines.
* Establish data\-quality standards covering freshness, completeness, reconciliation and SLAs.
* Work with engineering to define APIs, mappings, integration specifications and technical requirements.
* Ensure appropriate PHI handling, data masking, access controls and compliance with HIPAA/SOC 2 requirements.
* Partner with operations teams to identify data and integration issues and drive product improvements.


 What We’re Looking For
   

  

**Must Have**
* 4–7 years of experience in Product Management, Product Ownership, Technical Business Analysis or Solution Architecture.
* Experience working on data platforms, integrations, APIs or technical products.
* Strong SQL skills — SQL will be assessed during the interview process.
* Hands\-on understanding of REST APIs, file feeds, SFTP, webhooks, retries and reconciliation.
* Strong understanding of data modelling and data warehousing concepts.
* Excellent written communication skills for creating product specifications, data dictionaries and integration documentation.
* B.Tech/B.E. or equivalent technical qualification.


 Good to Have
   

  

* Experience in US Healthcare / Revenue Cycle Management (RCM).
* Knowledge of X12 EDI – 837, 835, 270/271, 276/277\.
* Experience with healthcare clearinghouses such as Availity, Waystar, Change Healthcare/Optum or TriZetto.
* Exposure to EHR/PM systems such as Epic, athenahealth, eClinicalWorks or AdvancedMD.
* Experience with Snowflake, Azure SQL, dbt or similar data pipeline technologies.
* Experience transitioning a services\-led process into a scalable product/platform.


 Why Join?
   

  

 This is an opportunity to own a
 **foundational data and integrations platform** 
 rather than a standalone product feature. You will work directly with live healthcare data, engineering and operations teams, with your work having a direct impact on
 **client collections and business outcomes** 
 .

 You Are
   

  

 You have spent years managing ASIC and IC design projects where the stakes are real, timelines are tight, and the difference between a successful tapeout and a missed window is your ability to see around corners. You know that the hardest part of delivering complex IP is not just the technical work, it is keeping cross\-functional teams aligned when R\&D, Marketing, Sales, and customers all have different definitions of "done."
   

  

 You do not manage by status reports alone. You get into the details when a SerDes PHY design hits a roadblock, understand the technical tradeoffs well enough to ask the right questions, and work with your engineers to find a path forward that does not compromise quality or schedule. You have learned that risk management is not about spreadsheets, it is about knowing which risks to escalate, which to mitigate quietly, and which conversations to have before they become problems.
   

  

 You are the kind of leader who can translate a customer's vague requirement into a concrete project scope, push back when timelines do not match reality, and still maintain trust on all sides. You care about process, but only when it makes the team faster and more effective, not for its own sake.
   

  

 At Synopsys, you will lead SerDes PHY IP projects that power the next generation of high\-speed connectivity in everything from data centers to automotive systems. The work is technical, the teams are global, and what you deliver will ship in products that matter.
   

  

 What You'll Be Doing
   

  

* Manage end\-to\-end delivery of high\-speed SerDes PHY IP projects from definition through tapeout and customer deployment
* Lead cross\-functional project teams including design engineers, verification engineers, and layout specialists to execute against aggressive schedules
* Partner with R\&D and Marketing to define project roadmaps, prioritize features, and align technical deliverables with market requirements
* Identify resource gaps, manage project risks, and resolve cross\-team dependencies before they block progress
* Drive process improvements across the engineering organization, implementing best practices that reduce cycle time and improve quality
* Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Support teams on pre\-sales technical engagement and post\-sales issue resolution
* Deliver regular status updates to executive leadership and customers, translating technical progress into business outcomes


 The Impact You Will Have
   

  

* Accelerate time\-to\-market for advanced SerDes IP that enables high\-speed connectivity in AI, automotive, and data center applications
* Enable customers to meet increasingly complex design requirements with proven, high\-quality IP that integrates cleanly into their SoCs
* Strengthen Synopsys' reputation as a trusted partner for mission\-critical semiconductor IP through consistent on\-time, on\-spec delivery
* Improve engineering efficiency across the organization by identifying bottlenecks and implementing scalable processes that work across multiple projects
* Foster tighter collaboration between R\&D, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Support, ensuring alignment from early concept through customer deployment
* Contribute directly to Synopsys' leadership position in high\-speed interface IP, supporting customers building the next generation of smart, connected devices
* Mentor project leads and engineers on your team, building organizational capability in technical program management and cross\-functional leadership


 What You'll Need
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field with 8\+ years of relevant experience, or Master's/PhD with 6\+ years
* Deep technical knowledge of IC design, ASIC development flows, and semiconductor IP integration, particularly in mixed\-signal or SerDes domains
* Proven track record leading complex engineering projects in a high\-tech environment, ideally in semiconductor IP or ASIC development
* Strong risk management and change management skills, with experience navigating technical uncertainty and scope changes without derailing schedules
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, you can explain technical tradeoffs to executives and translate customer requirements into actionable engineering plans
* Experience with SerDes PHY IP, high\-speed interface standards like PCIe, USB, or Ethernet is a strong plus
* Familiarity with project management methodologies and tools, whether Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid approaches tailored to hardware development


 Who You Are
   

  

* You can walk into a project review, quickly assess whether the team is on track or at risk, and ask the two questions that get to the real issue
* When a customer escalation lands on your desk, you do not panic or deflect, you pull the right people together, get to root cause, and own the path to resolution
* You are comfortable pushing back on unrealistic timelines or under\-scoped requirements, but you do it in a way that builds trust rather than defensiveness
* You see process improvement as a means to an end, not a goal in itself, and you know the difference between a process that helps and one that just adds overhead
* You are detail\-oriented enough to catch a missed dependency in a project plan, but strategic enough to keep the team focused on what actually moves the needle
* You adapt quickly when priorities shift, resources change, or a technical assumption turns out to be wrong, and you help your team do the same without losing momentum


 The Team You'll Be Part Of
   

  

 Join our Mixed\-Signal Semiconductor IP team, a collaborative group driving innovation in high\-speed SerDes solutions for next\-generation devices.
   

  

 Rewards and Benefits
   

  

 We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

description:
**Job Description**
 The Oracle Health
 **Medication Administration** 
 team is responsible for delivering solutions that help clinicians safely and efficiently administer medications across acute, ambulatory, and specialty care settings. Medication administration is one of the most critical moments in the care delivery process, directly impacting patient safety, clinical outcomes, regulatory compliance, operational efficiency, and clinician experience.
   

  

 Our mission is to support and evolve medication administration workflows through intuitive, reliable, and highly integrated solutions that reduce cognitive burden, streamline nursing workflows, and improve patient safety. This includes maintaining existing medication administration capabilities that customers depend on today, while also modernizing traditional workflows through interoperability, mobile experiences, barcode medication administration, clinical decision support, workflow optimization, and emerging AI\-enabled capabilities.
   

  

 We are seeking a
 **Senior Product Manager** 
 to help manage, enhance, and modernize medication administration capabilities within Oracle Health’s Electronic Health Record. In this role, you will balance support for existing and legacy product capabilities with the development of new workflows, modernization initiatives, and future\-state medication administration experiences.
   

  

 You will partner closely with nursing leaders, pharmacists, physicians, customers, engineering teams, UX designers, clinical informaticists, quality, regulatory, consulting, and customer\-facing teams to deliver solutions that improve the safety, efficiency, usability, and reliability of medication administration workflows.
   

  

 You will be responsible for understanding customer needs, defining product requirements, prioritizing investments, supporting roadmap execution, and guiding product development from concept through delivery and adoption. This role requires a product manager who can operate across current\-state product support, customer commitments, regulatory and safety expectations, technical modernization, and future\-state product innovation.
   

  

 Your work will directly impact clinicians caring for patients every day while helping Oracle Health advance the next generation of medication management.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Product Strategy, Roadmap, and Portfolio Execution: Contribute to the strategic direction and roadmap for medication administration capabilities across the Oracle Health platform. Balance enhancement requests, customer commitments, regulatory needs, technical debt, customer feedback, defects, lifecycle considerations, and modernization investments across both existing and future\-state product capabilities.
* Existing Product Support and Lifecycle Management: Support the ongoing evolution of existing and legacy medication administration capabilities that are currently used by Oracle Health customers. Evaluate customer issues, workflow gaps, adoption barriers, technical constraints, and lifecycle needs to inform prioritization, sustainment decisions, modernization plans, and customer communication.
* Product Requirements and Feature Definition: Translate customer needs, clinical workflow requirements, regulatory expectations, modernization priorities, and market opportunities into clear product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and workflow documentation. Partner closely with engineering and UX teams throughout the development lifecycle to ensure requirements are actionable, testable, and aligned to product intent.
* Clinical Workflow Expertise: Develop deep understanding of medication administration workflows, including barcode medication administration, medication scanning, medication scheduling, infusion management, documentation, exception handling, medication safety checks, and clinical communication. Ensure solutions align with real\-world nursing practice across both current customer workflows and future\-state product experiences.
* Customer and User Engagement: Engage with customers, external stakeholders, and internal stakeholders to understand workflow challenges, ensure product capabilities align with customer needs, gather feedback, and support adoption. Act as the voice of the customer while balancing individual customer needs with scalable product direction.
* Patient Safety and Quality Focus: Champion patient safety by identifying opportunities to reduce medication errors, improve compliance with medication administration policies, strengthen documentation quality, and enhance decision support during medication administration workflows. Ensure product decisions appropriately account for clinical risk, usability, reliability, and safety in high\-stakes care settings.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Partner with engineering, UX, clinical informatics, interoperability, quality assurance, regulatory, consulting, support, customer success, and customer\-facing teams to deliver high\-quality solutions that meet customer and market needs. Drive alignment across stakeholders when priorities, ownership, dependencies, or tradeoffs are unclear.
* Workflow Modernization and Innovation: Drive modernization initiatives focused on improving usability, mobility, automation, workflow efficiency, and product scalability. Evaluate emerging technologies, including AI and intelligent automation, to identify opportunities that create measurable value for clinicians while maintaining trust, safety, and operational readiness.
* Regulatory and Compliance Alignment: Ensure product capabilities support applicable healthcare regulations, accreditation standards, medication safety practices, privacy, security, and documentation requirements. Partner with regulatory, quality, clinical safety, and engineering stakeholders to ensure both existing and new capabilities remain aligned with evolving compliance expectations.
* Product Delivery, Release Readiness, and Adoption: Support release planning, dependency tracking, customer readiness, documentation, training, enablement, and adoption strategies. Measure outcomes and continuously improve products based on customer feedback, support trends, usage data, workflow observations, and product performance metrics.
* Market and Industry Awareness: Maintain awareness of healthcare industry trends, nursing informatics practices, medication safety initiatives, competitor offerings, interoperability standards, and evolving technology expectations. Use market and customer insights to inform roadmap decisions, modernization priorities, and investment recommendations.


**Qualifications**
 Career Level \- IC3

 Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life\-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
   

  

 True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute.  We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process.  Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer.  Founded in 2000 by Dilip Modi, Spice Money Limited is India’s leading rural fintech company, headquartered in Noida and operating as a subsidiary of DiGiSPICE Technologies Limited, a publicly listed entity. The company is driven by a strong mission to accelerate financial inclusion and empower the underserved “Bharat” through technology\-enabled financial services.
 



 With a network of 1\.6\+ million Adhikaris across India, the company enables last\-mile access to essential services including AEPS cash withdrawal and deposits, domestic money transfer, bill payments, insurance, micro\-ATM services, credit solutions, travel bookings, account opening, and UPI\-led digital payments. Spice Money has consistently introduced industry\-first innovations such as a zero\-cost Adhikari platform, one of India’s largest assisted payments networks, a rural credit marketplace, and Spice Money UPI \& Spice Pay wallet to accelerate digital adoption in smaller towns and villages.
 



 Operating across 95%\+ pincodes with a team of 1,000\+ employees, Spice Money combines the agility of a high\-growth fintech with the scale and impact of a nationwide distribution network—creating meaningful economic opportunities and driving the next phase of financial inclusion in India.
 



  





**Why This Role Matters:** 




 This role is critical in defining the strategic direction and long\-term success of an end\-to\-end product domain. As a domain lead, you will chart a 12–18 month strategy, make key trade\-off choices, and independently set domain priorities that drive business growth and platform stability. In addition to driving domain outcomes, you will lead cross\-functional squads and mentor junior product managers. Depending on organizational assignment, the role may oversee domains such as Adhikari onboarding and KYC, assisted payments, merchant acceptance, lending, insurance, growth and engagement, internal sales tools, risk/compliance platforms, or shared product infrastructure. Across all domains, you will be accountable for balancing customer value, business viability, technical feasibility, operational simplicity, platform reliability, and regulatory compliance.

 Formulate and execute a comprehensive 12–18 month product domain strategy that directly supports revenue, margin, and business expansion goals.

 Independently establish product priorities, balance competing demands, and make strategic choices within your domain.
* **Squad Leadership \& People Development:** 
 Lead and actively coach junior PMs to foster team growth and high execution standards.
* **End\-to\-End Metric Ownership:** 
 Take ultimate P\&L/performance responsibility for domain health, including revenue contribution, margins, active adoption, retention loops, system reliability, and minimization of fraud/ operational losses.

 Deliver solutions that harmoniously integrate customer value, business viability, scalable architecture, operational simplicity, high availability, and strict adherence to regulatory guidelines.
* **Cross\-Functional Alignment:** 
 Partner with senior business, risk, operations, and technology leaders to align domain goals with broad company objectives.



  





**What Will Make You Successful:** 



* **Education \& Experience:** 
 B.Tech/BE or MBA (preferably from Tier\-1 institutes) with 4–6 years of overall experience, including 4\+ years in core Product Management owning full domain lifecycles in Fintech, Digital Payments, or high\-scale Tech Startups.

 Experience driving 12–18 month strategies, making complex portfolio choices, and leading multi\-disciplinary product squads.

 A track record of coaching junior team members and building high performing product practices.

 Strong capability to connect product metrics directly to top\-line revenue, bottom\-line margins, risk controls, and system stability.

 Deep insight into rural merchant behaviors, assisted tech adoption, and designing intuitive digital journeys for underserved markets.

 Outstanding stakeholder management skills to articulate strategic trade\-offs and drive consensus across business and technical leadership.

Requisition Id: 1743512
   

  

 As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we hire and develop the most passionate people in their field to help build a better working world. This starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom. At EY, we don't just focus on who you are now, but who you can become. We believe that it’s your career and ‘It’s yours to build’ which means potential here is limitless and we'll provide you with motivating and fulfilling experiences throughout your career to help you on the path to becoming your best professional self.
   

  

**The opportunity** 
 : Senior Consultant\-GOV\-Business Consulting PI\-CNS \- BC \- Transformation Delivery \- Noida
   

  

**GOV :**
 Our Global Government \& Public Sector (GPS) is a network of highly skilled professionals dedicated to serving our clients by bringing best\-in\-class international experience and insight combined with local knowledge to solve the most critical problems facing governments today. We actively focus on building solutions that help public sector entities face the challenges of the future and reinvent themselves.
   

  

 Digital transformation is not just about new technologies; it involves an overhaul of organizational structures, governance, work processes, culture and mindset. It also means realizing a wider vision of relationships and business models that will redesign how public services function.
   

  

 To achieve this vision, we help clients balance strategic choices to re\-ignite performance. We have developed a suite of cross\-service line strategic solutions that align with our client priorities.
   

  

 We have a proud record of helping governments meet their challenges head\-on, and we work closely with them to build a world that works better for all citizens.
   

  

**CNS \- BC \- Transformation Delivery :**
 EY Consulting is building a better working world by transforming businesses through the power of people, technology and innovation. Our client\-centric approach focuses on driving long\-term value for our clients by solving their most strategic problems. EY Consulting is made up of three sub\-service lines: Business Consulting (including Performance Improvement and Risk Consulting), Technology Consulting and People Advisory Services.
   

  

 Business Consulting works with clients to reimagine or transform their business purpose and model; create growth; manage cost and efficiency; respond to market pressures and regulation; and resolve operational challenges. The scope of this team encompasses innovation, strategy and purpose, through deep functional experience in business transformation, finance, supply chain and operations, providing support for the complex and large\-scale program and portfolio management.
   

  

 It has multiple fields of play such as:
   

  

 Finance Consulting \- helps assess and transform our clients' finance function to improve performance and effectiveness. We help organizations implement service and cost improvement initiatives, and embed a performance management process and culture that unites the business around its core objectives.
   

  

 Business Transformation \- a m?ultidisciplinary competency, gathering capabilities in transformation architecture, experience design, business design and transformation execution to problem\-solve, design and deliver large scale, multi\-year, multi\-stakeholder transformation programs.
   

  

 Supply Chain and Operations \- we provide a unique combination of industry\-specific, strategic, operational and financial insights, digital technology advances and strategic alliance partners to deliver better outcomes and also help clients effect fundamental change in their operations’ performance to support sales growth, become more cost competitive, minimize risk and ensure operational resilience.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Excellence**
* Should have experience on urban planning, citizen\-centric planning, service delivery enhancement, long\-term institutional goals, monitoring of other vendors/other consultants
* Should have worked with Government (Centre/State/ULB) in India


**Skills And Attributes**
**To qualify for the role you must have**
**Qualification**
* Master of Commerce
* Master of Business Administration
* Master of Engineering in Electronics
* Master of Design
* Master of Architecture


**Experience**
* Project Management (6\+ years)


**What We Look For**
 People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.
   

  

**What We Offer**
 Fuelled by the brilliance of our people, EY has emerged as the strongest brand and the most attractive employer in our field, with market\-leading growth over competitors. Our people work side\-by\-side with market\-leading entrepreneurs, game\-changers, disruptors, and visionaries. As an organization, we are investing more time, technology, and money than ever before in skills and learning for our people. At EY, you will have a personalized Career Journey and also the chance to tap into the resources of our career frameworks to better know about your roles, skills, and opportunities.
   

  

 EY is equally committed to being an inclusive employer, and we strive to achieve the right balance for our people—enabling us to deliver excellent client service while allowing our people to build their careers as well as focus on their wellbeing.
   

  

 If you can confidently demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.
   

  

 Join us in shaping the future with confidence. Apply Now
